theme: Luxury Dark Theme with Gold Accents (AuraMart Luxe)

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-bold tracking-tight text-amber-100
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-semibold text-amber-200 tracking-tight

visual_enhancers.gold_button: bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-600 via-yellow-500 to-amber-600 hover:from-amber-500 hover:to-yellow-400 text-black font-semibold shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(212,175,55,0.3)] transition-all duration-300
visual_enhancers.metallic_text: bg-clip-text text-transparent bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-200 via-yellow-400 to-amber-100 font-serif

motion.page_transition: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 15 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.4 }}

hero_banner.description: Rose gold luxury watch on obsidian fabric
Luxurious perfume bottle with sparkling golden bokeh background

accessibility.contrast_ratio: Ensure gold text on dark background passes 3:1 for headers and 4.5:1 for body (use text-slate-200 or text-amber-100 instead of dim gold on gray).
accessibility.test_ids: MUST include data-testid on all buttons, forms, login inputs, product cards, order status toggles, and modal triggers (e.g. data-testid='admin-login-submit', data-testid='ai-generate-btn', data-testid='order-status-select').

instructions_to_main_agent.auth_flow: Ensure Admin authentication uses secure password checking (default password provided or configurable via state/env) with session state management and route protection for '/admin/*'. Storefront homepage remains publicly accessible.
instructions_to_main_agent.ai_generator: Implement simulated/live AI product generator that takes wholesale links or titles, calculates 3.5x-4x profit margins, writes viral selling points, SEO tags, and formats full luxury product listings.
instructions_to_main_agent.ai_media_generator: Implement AI video & banner section in admin panel. Allow generating simulated 10-second cinematic video banners, selecting active hero banners, and pushing updates live to the storefront.
instructions_to_main_agent.orders_management: Provide comprehensive order table with status badge switching (Pending, Confirmed, Dispatched, Delivered, Cancelled), full customer modal/drawer view, and Shiprocket / Delhivery fulfillment mock payload trigger.
instructions_to_main_agent.ui_vibe: Strict dark theme (#0B0B0E) with warm champagne gold accents (#D4AF37), glassmorphism cards, serif headlines, and smooth hover interactions. Avoid generic blue/white SaaS look.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Always specify transition properties (e.g. transition-colors duration-200).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp metallic buttons with interaction animations).
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use lucide-react icons instead.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
All key interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes.
